chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no harm in paying the zakat two months early and delaying it two months."
ai.seo_question: Can I pay my zakat early or late according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted through the reliable chain of Hammad ibn Uthman, clarifies the temporal flexibility in fulfilling the obligation of zakat. It establishes a permissible window of four months (two months before and two after the due date), reflecting the Shia juristic principle of facilitating worship while maintaining the sanctity of the deadline. This ruling underscores the balance between strict adherence to divine command and practical ease for the believer.
